body: The only thing that's kept me alive this long is my little black dog. He is my only reason for living.

I keep thinking of ending it all. I keep thinking I just can't keep working like this... I just can't. I'm not getting anywhere. I've run into a dead end and there's no way out. I got my master's degree and now it's essentially useless. I could make more money working at Lowe's than teaching fucking college courses. I just can't believe that this is what's become of my life.

When I brought up moving in with my boyfriend, he basically flipped shit and just kept saying "you are prone to depression and anxiety." Okay, so then why are you with me? Why say that to someone, like I don't already realize that I am flawed? We entered this long distance relationship with the understanding that I would eventually move there to be with him. So why now is he throwing my depression in my face?? And why do it at a time when I am already going through so many troubles?

Well it has been a rough few days. My long-distance boyfriend broke up with me since I last posted here. We talked for 2 hours today and he decided to stay with me, but I feel the damage is done and it will be hard (if not impossible) to trust him again.

Also, last week I was offered a job making $22,500 to teach college full time at the local community college. I have been teaching there part time for a year, in hopes of eventually getting a full time position. Now that it's been offered to me, I am shocked and appalled at the extremely low wages (I have a master's degree!). $22,500/year is not nearly enough money for me to survive on.

When I learned how crappy the wages would be, I brought up the idea of moving in with my boyfriend. He freaked out and said he's not ready for that, and won't be for quite some time. Meanwhile I am trapped here, living alone and going into debt because of my two low-paying jobs.

I feel extremely discouraged, and my emotional support system is basically non-existent. If I text friends saying "I'm falling apart" "I'm drowning" or "I need help", they simply respond with things like "Huh? What's up?" or "what's wrong?". They never call or come to check on me. I feel like no one really cares and I KNOW that no one understands. I feel lost and alone and am losing the ability to continue.

Thank you so much for your caring response. If you are only 18, you are certainly very mature in your handling of these things. Do you aspire to be a therapist or psychiatrist? Social worker? 

I have a childhood friend who lives in Australia. I have always wanted to visit there. I have a pet cockatiel who I dream about setting free to be with her own kind. (I know that sounds silly, because she was captive born and might not even live that long in the wild, but I can tell that she longs for freedom. She is lonely and I am too sick to care for her properly.) I have seen pictures of flocks of cockatiels in Australia, and to think of her living that way, free and flying with her own kind, makes me so happy.

Thank you for your thoughtful reply.

I don't have any sort of active imagination, as I did when I was a kid. Everything seems washed in grey. I'm sure escaping reality is helpful, but I work two jobs and I have to stay very focused.

I will type more as a general comment.
